registration_scope: New development comparison after the earlier MAP/scarcity results were exposed. Protocol and final code freeze precede this study's predictions and target scores. No independent biological confirmation claim.
question: Can a condition-bound knowledge mean adapter and one purchased A observation correct frozen near-boundary comparisons on B better than no update and equally supported simple controls?
endpoint: Existing signed named39geneRNA scalar. Larger is preferable under the original packet convention. Not viability, apoptosis phenotype, protein activity or authenticated financial utility.

data.eligible_contexts: All 43 rows with complete A and B availability; exclude incomplete rows31/34 before outcome-based selection.
data.history_sampling: Reuse SeedSequence([seed,held_row]) permutation of the other42 complete contexts; nested prefixes, sorted after sampling.
data.representation_inputs: Authenticated released molecule256/knowledge1024 caches, Morgan2048, fixed whole-identity-permuted knowledge; dose/unit binding preserved.
data.public_target_inputs: Only target basal expression, frozen STATE scalar prediction/support, menu and conditions. Target A is accessible only via the charged one-action callback. Target B is evaluator-only.
data.independence: Reference contexts overlap STATE pretraining. A/B are original packet partitions, not newly collected independent cultures. Three history draws are repeated development cases, not independent biological replicates.

decision_definition.initial_prior: Original precision-weighted training B mean plus0.5 times target STATE deviation from training STATE mean; reimplement without touching target B.
decision_definition.pairs: Freeze nine comparisons: baseline ranks3/4/5 crossed with ranks6/7/8. One-based ranks, stable ascending candidate index ties. Construct before any target A/B and use the same pairs for every arm.
decision_definition.one_A_action: From the baseline full146 prior, buy the candidate closest to the midpoint of ranks5 and6, stable candidate-index tie. All feedback arms buy this same candidate once.
decision_definition.terminal_action: Commit five full-menu B indices by coherent candidate-score ordering; no candidate filtering based on coverage or held outcomes.
decision_definition.cost: No-feedback arms commit5 B units; feedback arms buy1 A then commit5 B units, cost6. Common cap6, idle capacity permitted. No simulated-profile to currency conversion.
decision_definition.budget_extension: Adaptive0-to8 A scheduling is deferred until one-A transfer passes. No new LLM calls in this experiment.
decision_definition.pair_ties: Exact equal candidate scores choose the lower candidate index, matching full-menu stable ranking; frozen left pair member need not have the lower index.

models.crossfit_residuals: Within each fitting history, leave one background out for the fixed prior and A/B offset. Candidate residuals and moment matrices use only remaining training data.
models.condition_gate: Apply the exact dose+unit equality mask as a Schur product to empirical and representation joint covariances, including A/B cross blocks. Existing role/readout/source contract is shared within this frozen packet; no claims of unseen time/dose interpolation.
models.observation_noise: Joint A/B residual second moments already include measurement variation. Do not add public obsvar or treat precision_B as authenticated measurement-error variance. Tiny numerical diagonal regularization1e-12 remains explicit.
models.base_covariance: Existing half diagonal shrink on joint residual moments; candidate kernels remain full-dimensional authenticated PSD cosine Grams. No unrestricted new covariance fit.
models.knowledge_mean_adapter: Tensor-product kernel ridge on crossfit B residuals: training-centered L2-normalized basal cosine times exact-condition drug kernel. Factorize only n-by-n cell and146-by146 drug kernels. Target inputs contain no labels. Identical model and tuning opportunities for molecule/Morgan/knowledge/permutation.
models.mean_adapter_selection: Null disables the correction. Choose lambda on inner pre-A frozen-pair regret, tie disables first. Retain the same selected lambda in its representation+feedback arm. Only B mean is adapted; A expected value stays baseline prior plus the training A-B offset.
models.feedback: For joint BB=C, BA column c and A variance v, mean_B +=alpha*c/v*(y_A-mu_A), covariance_B -=alpha*c*c'/v. Scalar alpha in[0,1] preserves coherent candidate comparisons and matches an additional-noise interpretation. This is not a new Gaussian update formula. The added-independent-noise interpretation applies to fixed alpha only; after observation-dependent robust gating, the covariance is a declared diagnostic surrogate, not an exact Gaussian posterior.
models.conditional_reliability_gate: For every representation+feedback arm, use positive cosine similarities between target and training-centered normalized basal states. n_eff=(sumw)^2/sum(w^2), zero on insufficient/n_eff<2 support; support factor=min(1,n_eff/4). Multiply selected alpha by this factor and min(1,3/abs(innovation_z)), where innovation_z uses fitted A variance. These are registered heuristics, not source truth or risk certificates. Insufficient support blocks feedback and retains pre-feedback uncertainty; it does not automatically disable the independently selected mean adapter.
models.probability_calibration: Inflate pair standard deviation by max(1,sqrt(mean innerOOF squared standardized pair prediction errors)) for each selected arm. Preserve no-update uncertainty when alpha0. Report Gaussian probabilities and empirical calibration diagnostics; no conformal, conditional-risk or time-uniform guarantee. Inflation multiplies pair standard deviation, equivalently covariance by its square.
models.inner_folds: Three folds by sorted training-position modulo3, with at least two fit rows. Means, state centering, residuals, kernels, adapter, tuning and scales refit within each inner fold. Each fit excludes inner held and outer target.
models.inner_objective: Mean continuous pairwise regret on each frozen nine-pair set, then average inner backgrounds. Alpha/eta tie preference favors less update; lambda tie favors disabled correction. Global MSE is diagnostic.
models.matched_strength_control: Fit one alpha for empirical feedback from trainingOOF expected squared frozen-pair movement, matching the selected knowledge+feedback increment relative to knowledge-only. Use fitted A variance rather than outer realized A/B; capalpha at1 and report achieved/target movement and cap/mismatch. This control does not match the mean-adapter main effect.
models.matched_strength_expectation: For the fixedGaussian standardized innovation Z, the robustupdate uses clip(Z,-3,3). E[clip(Z,-3,3)^2]=1-6*phi(3)+16*SF(3). Average trainingOOF (selectedalpha*statesupport)^2*(c_i-c_j)^2/v times this factor and match its RMS against empirical full expected RMS. Neither realized inner innovation amplitude nor outer A/B is used for matching.

controls.fixed_shrink: Empirical one-A update withalpha0.1, no representation mean adapter.
controls.cv_shrink: Empirical alpha chosen by inner pair regret, no representation mean adapter.
controls.strong_simple: Choose among no_update, empirical_full, fixed_shrink, cv_shrink and gated_cv_shrink by inner regret, tie order as listed. Store training-side choice; never select the best on evaluation B.
controls.knowledge_feedback_only: Use selected knowledge covariance/reliability and same one-A innovation with no mean adapter; diagnostic isolation of feedback increment.
controls.selective_knowledge: Same knowledge feedback scores; only accept the proposed top5 replacement if every incoming-versus-outgoing Gaussian pair has probability>=0.95, otherwise retain initial top5. Pair-level selective decisions separately require probability>=0.95 or<=0.05. Nominal model protection only.
controls.gated_cv_shrink: Empirical covariance, no mean adapter, alpha selected with the same inner regret grid and identical state-support/outlier gates as representation feedback. Isolates protection without biological knowledge.

metrics.primary: Mean pair regret: max(B_i,B_j) minus B of score-selected winner, averaged across frozen nine pairs within episode. Improvement=no_update regret minus updated regret. Continuous B values do not certify underlying biological wins.
metrics.flips: Count corrected, harmful and ambiguous score-order reversals relative to baseline. Exact-zero B ties within1e-12 are ambiguous; separately report fixed0.001 RNA difference-band sensitivity. This band is a sensitivity definition, not measured replicate uncertainty.
metrics.coverage: Fraction of frozen pairs whose order flips; probability-qualified pair coverage reported separately so abstention cannot masquerade as efficacy.
metrics.calibration: Pair Brier score, five fixed-bin calibration summaries, Gaussian interval diagnostic coverage and inflation scales. Binary observed B ordering, with exact ties excluded. No independent risk certification.
metrics.secondary: Finaltop5 B sum/regret, replacement identities, harmful replacements, globalRNA MSE, purchased A/cost, condition/support/outlier refusals and actual runtimes.
metrics.factorial_interaction: U(knowledge_feedback)-U(knowledge_only)-U(gated_cv_shrink)+U(no_update), separately for negative pair regret and terminaltop5 utility. Gated empirical feedback isolates the same reliability heuristic without knowledge. This is an interaction between frozen algorithms, not causal biological synergy.

analysis_and_gate.unit: Average three seed results inside each outer background first, yielding43 paired context units per history size; pairs and seeds never increase the independent denominator.
analysis_and_gate.multiplicity: One-sided paired t-tests on context-level regret improvements with Holm correction across these five primary comparisons. Also report nominal paired95%t intervals. Overlapping histories/development exposure limit inference; no deployment risk guarantee.
analysis_and_gate.benefit_gate: At n8, knowledge_feedback must have positive regret improvement and Holmadjustedp<=0.05 against every primary comparator; against no_update improvement must be>=0.001 RNAunits. Harmful/totalflip ratio<=0.10, flip coverage>=0.05, and Brier<=inner-selectedsimple Brier+0.01. Zero flips fails coverage. Registered development screen only.
analysis_and_gate.promotion: No src/tools promotion from this exposed development study even if gate passes. Fresh independently qualified A/B units and functional endpoint/cost evidence are separately required.

execution.freeze: Parent hashes final protocol, producer, tests and all input/source/cache dependencies before new model fitting or target scores. Build persists all choices, baseline pairs/q and support before A. Update persists charged receipts and all predictions/probabilities/final commitments and hashes before evaluator accesses target B.
execution.replay: Refuse overwrite; keep original study outputs and earlier MAP freezes unchanged. Independent verifier self-freezes before new score inspection and reconstructs splits, models, commitments, receipts, metrics and gate.
execution.integrity_checks: Wrong-dose propagation forbidden; only charged A may enter; target B poisoning must leave histories/choices/actions/forecasts unchanged; no double-counted observation noise; no feedback support andalpha0 preserve the pre-feedback mean(base plus any selected adapter) and pre-feedback covariance; shrinking mean also reduces covariance reduction.
